messages:
maria: Quick ops/legal handshake for the Snowflake + Databricks vector connector marketplace listing. Need: final marketplace manifest, security attestation, DPA clause check, and joint announcement timeline. cc @owen @kai :wave:
sanjay: I can drop the final manifest here. small changes from the last draft: added `compatibility->delta-lake` flag and a `max-ingest-rate` hint. still need an approver for security attestation.
kai: timeline note — marketing wants a soft announcement 1 week after cert, full joint blog + partner webinar 3 weeks after. we should lock dates by EOD Fri. :calendar:
partners-bot: created event "marketplace-cert-go/no-go" for 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC and invited: maria, kai, sanjay, owen.
lisa: from legal: need to confirm data processing boundaries. please include a short doc that states: no customer PII persists in vector DBs, and delete/retention policy for embeddings. also add whether Snow/DBX host any customer data transiently.
owen: also need encryption at rest + KMS scope. if we are sharing any logs with partners, list the fields. legal will need a one-pager before signing the marketplace agreement.
sanjay: copying manifest snippet here (small):
```json
{
  "name": "redwood-vector-snow-dbx-adapter",
  "versions": ["v1.0.0"],
  "compatibility": ["snowflake-3.x","databricks-9.x"],
  "hints": {"max-ingest-rate":"1000/documents/min", "requires-kms":"true"}
}
```
This is what the cert team will load into the staging registry.
maria: thanks. ops question: for the staging cert run, do we need on-prem hardware from the partner or can we run against their managed test accounts?
sanjay: partner-provided managed test accounts are fine for functional checks, but perf and scaling cert need a DGX instance (or similar) to reproduce latency SLOs. we can do perf smoke on smaller infra but must note in the cert report that peak numbers are extrapolated.
kai: marketing needs two things from us for the announcement pack: 1) verified throughput + latency numbers (per model/worker config), 2) a partner quote + joint logo assets. can ops/eng own #1 and partnerships own #2?
maria: agreed. action owners: sanjay -> perf numbers & staging run (due Tue), owen -> legal one-pager & DPA check (due Wed), kai -> partner quote + brand assets (due Wed), lisa -> final marketplace T&Cs signoff (on review). I'll coordinate the go/no-go call.
partners-bot: uploaded doc "marketplace-manifest-v1.json" to /shared/partnerships/marketplace/ with link: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/manifest-v1
owsan: quick question for legal: does our default DPA cover vector-embedding retention, or do we need an addendum for indexed vectors?
owen: default DPA covers derived embeddings if de-identification is documented. we need the retention window and purge mechanism spelled out. please add to the one-pager.
lisa: noted. also: include a short security checklist for cert (auth, network egress rules, KMS scope, logging fields, breach notif SLA). I'll template it.
sanjay: i'll attach a sample egress rule snippet we used in the pilot: `allow: ["*.dbx.partner.net:443","api.snowflakecomputing.com:443"]` and a note to block 3rd-party telemetry by default.
maria: perfect. last operational ask: can eng run a dry deploy to staging 48h before the go/no-go so we have time to fix infra issues?
sanjay: yes, scheduling a dry deploy on Mon 09:00 UTC. I'll post the runbook link once it's created.
kai: update to timeline: if all owners hit due dates, announce plan stands: soft-campaign week-of May 19, joint webinar June 2. otherwise we'll slip one week.
maria: thanks everyone. i'll collate notes and ping again with the invite for the go/no-go. :thumbsup:
partners-bot: reminder set for 2026-05-12 15:45 UTC: "pre-check for marketplace cert"
